name: study
description: One private Study plugin for independent Berkeley bCourses and Hanyang HY-ON accounts, with shared Canvas capabilities and Hanyang extensions.

interface.shortDescription: Berkeley and Hanyang coursework in one private connection
interface.longDescription: Connect Berkeley bCourses and Hanyang HY-ON accounts independently inside one Study plugin. Read courses, assignments, submissions, grades, Inbox, announcements and files. Both accounts support explicitly requested uploads, assignment submissions and single-recipient Inbox send/reply with attachments. The Hanyang account also supports LearningX, timetable and saved Lecture transcripts.
defaultPrompt: Review my Berkeley assignments and submission status.
Check today's Hanyang classes and unfinished work.
Show the selected school account before checking deadlines.
